notes.title: Progress Update
notes.content:
Making an indie game isn’t just about coding or designing a fun experience. Unfortunately, a lot of time also has to go into marketing, updating pages, building a community of interested players, and much more.

Over the past few months, I’ve focused on content creation to help Star Life stand out. A bigger community means more feedback and a stronger launch, so I believe all this effort is worthwhile. I’ve made YouTube Shorts part of my routine and have streamed on Twitch weekly without missing a single session. There’s a lot for me to learn on this front, but as always, discipline and hard work are key.

I’ve also been thinking hard about improving the game itself. A huge, possibly revolutionary change is on the horizon. I want to deliver a solid product that earns players’ respect. Like many developers, I’m juggling a day job, game marketing, and development, but I still believe it’s achievable in 2025. Let’s see how it goes!

P.S. We have got a new game capsule!

notes.title: Playtest is coming
notes.content:
Happy to announce that the playtest for Star Life will be finally launching on Steam next week! This is a fantastic opportunity for you to dive into the very first playtest and support Star Life by giving instrumental feedback.

I (Star Life dev) will read every feedback and will respond to it (ways of communication TBD, but likely through Discord). Any critical feedback will be extremely well met, as it will allow me to focus on improving game to ensure the ultimate goal of players getting best experience possible!

[b]Playtest Details:[/b]
- Start Date: 17th January 2025
- End Date: 26th January 2025
- Platforms: PC via Steam
- How to Join: Simply visit our Steam page and opt in to participate in the playtest.


[b]What to Expect:[/b]
- Most mechanics available
- One Solar system to test (trust me, it can take you days before you conquer it)
- Generally balanced game
- Save & Load are likely to be disabled for this Playtest to avoid unexpected issues

[b]Follow Us:[/b]
Stay updated by following us on our official social media channels and our Steam page for the latest news and announcements.

See you in a week time!
